camel_example: aliyun dataworks-public DeployFile --region cn-hangzhou --ProjectIdentifier dw_project --Comment First_release_task --ProjectId 10000 --NodeId 2000001 --FileId 10000001
description_en: Deploys a file to the production environment
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public deploy-file --project-id 10000 --project-identifier dw_project --file-id 10000001 --comment First_release_task --node-id 2000001 --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeployFile

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the DataWorks workspace.

You can log on to the DataWorks console and go to the workspace configuration page to obtain the workspace ID. You must specify either this parameter or ProjectIdentifier to determine the DataWorks workspace for this API call
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。
您可以登录DataWorks管控台，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。该参数与ProjectIdentifier参数，二者必须设置其一，用来确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the DataWorks workspace.

You can log on to the DataWorks console and go to the workspace configuration page to obtain the workspace name. You must specify either this parameter or ProjectId to determine the DataWorks workspace for this API call
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间名称。
您可以登录DataWorks控制台，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间名称。该参数与ProjectId参数，二者必须设置其一，用来确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_identifier

parameters.help_en: The ID of the file. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html to query the file ID. You need to specify only one of this parameter and the NodeId parameter settings
parameters.help_zh: 文件的ID，您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html查询对应文件的ID。该参数与NodeId参数配置一个即可
parameters.name: file_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the node in the scheduling system that corresponds to the file to be published.

You need to specify only one of this parameter and the FileId parameter settings
parameters.help_zh:
待发布文件在调度系统对应的任务ID。
该参数与FileId参数配置一个即可
parameters.name: node_id

Data.description_en: The ID of the deployment package. You must pass this ID as a parameter when you call the [GetDeployment]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173950.html） operation to obtain the details of this deployment
Data.description_zh: 发布包的ID。后续需要将该ID作为参数调用[GetDeployment]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173950.html）接口，获取本次发布的具体情况

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:

true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功。
取值如下：
true：调用成功。
